Keir was given the head and the clan was named Manoevkor.Fafaikor was given the intestine and the clan was named Juaiko.The last born(Jookuar -hoosy) was given the stomach the clan was named Rumbieh.These three clan umbrella name was given Sukandi.And these means "rat eaters".

name: 2025-04-24 12:18Juaiko clan boundary
cmt: Philip Jukaro- A man named Nafenson and his wife (Heeneki) lived here in Ujaikir. The bore a baby boy so the husband went to looking for grubs to feed the baby.He went all the way to Baneghey, Kiremo,Kandejama,Sagoembi and to Mafuaf looking for grubs and the baby started crying so the mother tried calling her husband to come quickly to quite the baby from crying.She also sang the lalaby called Hurin for the baby to stop crying and go to sleep.When teaching Huuvro and Kadiakara the baby died and the grubs were poured out there, therefore, the grubs around these place won't be collected to be eaten.There are also several similar places located close by,but are identified as"No-go zones ".The places are none other than Jet Akar,Namuhun and the wooharl fall or Marn Hurivaja.If you do go around there,your first born sons or daughters will die and the thunders will strike with rain and wind.And Ndamban fall and the Taffkin -fall are about the height some 60m, and about some meters up-stream Bareji from the Taffkin fall is the deepest river bank in the clan area by the name of Djinangari.
